why_next: The next question is chosen from the ROOT CAUSE the audit identified, not from the estimator. This run collected real evidence on a real substrate and still produced no valid inference, but the reason is now known rather than guessed, and it is a substrate-information property, not an estimator defect: across 15 action templates on 6 credential-free public origins, only 2 templates on a single origin (api.github.com) produced any identifier-varying response; the other 9 held-out templates returned exactly one status and one body for every identifier, so treatment-minus-B1 is exactly 0 there; and 2 of the 5 test sites returned only HTTP 429 for every request. Because the inference unit is the site, the realised design had 5 clusters and 118 distinct site-resample compositions, against a prereg power calculation that assumed 20 sites and about 900 held-out cases. A richer estimator cannot fix an absence of per-identifier variation, and the frozen design was in any case unable to license a verdict twice over (s9.1's >2.0 nats PC threshold is arithmetically unattainable, max attainable -0.20202707317519467 nats; conditions 3, 4 and 5 fail). So the next question makes three deliberate changes rather than retuning this one. First, it changes the substrate CLASS: page-level navigational GETs on HTML documents, whose identifier variation is structurally different from API query endpoints whose signature is dominated by a constant status and body. Second, it makes a hashed PRE-FREEZE variation-coverage screen the admission criterion, so sites that cannot contribute identifier variation can never silently dilute a site-clustered interval again, and so the pool is frozen by construction and hashed by the freezer rather than referred to from inside the prereg. Third, it makes the mechanism-declaration ablation the SINGLE discriminating contrast, with the treatment and its comparator sharing the same key and the same site-conditioned fallback, so the arms differ only in the mechanism object; this is what makes B1-vs-treatment a clean question, because in this packet B1's fallback is P(sig | site, action_template), the very key the treatment's M0 residual uses, so the two arms differed only where a non-M0 mechanism changed a prediction and the +0.0158-nat increment is uninterpretable as mechanism structure. It also carries forward the two instrument repairs this packet did establish: a null-control reference matched on the treatment's conditioning key (the per-site marginal oracle, not a global marginal), and preregistered thresholds proven attainable against the frozen metric's dynamic range before freeze. This is explicitly NOT a fourth certification battery of the kind the parent packet's handoff warned against, and NOT a re-thresholding of this freeze: the freeze is spent. It is also not the only admissible direction. The C-WEB-DYNAMICS registry next_gate's orthogonal programs (effect factorization, barriers, timescales, geometry, multiscale dynamics) remain open and unblocked; they are simply not reachable on a substrate of credential-free read-only GETs, which carries no genuine state dynamics, so that choice is a Global Research Director call and is recorded in dependencies.

PREREGISTRATION-COMPUTABILITY DEFECT, a reusable rule for every lane. An absolute positive-control threshold must be checked for attainability against the frozen metric's dynamic range BEFORE freeze. prereg s9.1 required log predictive density > 2.0 nats, while the frozen 10-component discrete signature with EPS=0.02 caps ANY predictor at 10*log(1-EPS) = -0.20202707317519467 nats (derived/metrics.json pc_threshold_attainability, s9_1_attainable false; Director re-derived this arithmetic independently). The same frozen file's s12 and s13 condition 6 require > -0.5 nats, which the PC meets at -0.12312145946864247 with Brier 0.00024373337940395315 over 10 test and 20 train identifiers. The two thresholds contradict each other inside one frozen file. This is the SECOND consecutive instance in this lane of a frozen accept branch that is unreachable before any measurement; the first was the empty accept region of EXP-PHYSICS-36287170603. Treat the recurrence, not the individual threshold, as the pattern.

NULL-CONTROL COMPARATOR MUST SHARE THE TREATMENT'S CONDITIONING KEY, a reusable rule derivable from the frozen text before any measurement. NC_INDEPENDENT_IID drew responses i.i.d. from each site's TRAIN marginal (prereg s9.3) yet s13 condition 8 required every predictor to perform at or below B3, a GLOBAL cold re-derivation, while s8.2 REQUIRED B1 to be keyed on (site, action_template) and the treatment inherits that key. Any predictor keyed that way must beat a global marginal on per-site-generated data with or without reading a mechanism, so the control cannot separate the two. The measured result is exactly consistent with that confound and rules out the alternative worry: on the i.i.d. data the treatment beats B3 by +2.22715786446959 nats but LOSES to the per-site marginal oracle, the strongest possible predictor of that generator, by -1.804152407854132 nats (derived/metrics.json iid_null; result.json controls.NC_INDEPENDENT_IID). No mechanism-specific structure is being hallucinated.

THE SUBSTRATE FACT THAT ACTUALLY EXPLAINS THE POWER FAILURE, and the most decision-relevant thing this lane now knows about its own substrate. Across 15 action templates on 6 credential-free public origins, only 2 templates produced any identifier-varying response, both on api.github.com (/repos/{id_1}/{id_2}|{id_2} with per-template delta +0.13012934626903075 and /users/{id_0}|{id_0} with +0.0433984931311957); the other 9 held-out templates returned exactly one status and one body for every identifier, so treatment-minus-B1 is exactly 0 there. Two of the five test sites contribute only rate-limit responses: api.agify.io returned HTTP 429 for 20 of 20 requests and api.genderize.io for 25 of 35, and 65 of 226 requests overall were 429. 4 of the 5 mandate-excluded candidates (httpbin.org, catfact.ninja, dog.ceo, ipify.org, plus api.chucknorris.io) are exactly the hosts that expose 200/404-varying identifier templates, and none of them was probed, so the retained pool had no replacement. Identifier-level P(S'|S,A) at the response-signature level therefore has almost no per-identifier variation to predict on credential-free read-only API query endpoints. This is an observation about the substrate, NOT about the Web's dynamics.

Inherited-mechanism conditioning improves on the strongest baseline B1_MARKOV_1ST_ORDER by +0.015775258127293593 nats log_score_categorical (treatment -4.033952953706143 vs B1 -4.049728211833437) and -0.00020584226453647717 brier_categorical (0.07338133888200837 vs 0.07358718114654486), with p_trajectory_grouped 0.00019998000199980003 and p_site_grouped 9.999000099990002e-05. THE POWER SHORTFALL IS STRUCTURAL, NOT MARGINAL. The inference unit is the site, so the realised design has 5 clusters, 66 held-out cases and 118 distinct site-resample compositions in 1000 draws, against a prereg calculation assuming 20 sites and about 900 held-out cases (derived/power_realisation.json power_at_assumed_site_count 0.25). No seed, estimator or re-uniting of metrics repairs an absent per-identifier variation, which is what the audit's V-N localisation establishes.
